fileheader.author: Unknown
fileheader.description: Cessna C-172 (modified for the TeachX Flight Simulator)
fileheader.note:
This model was created using publicly available data, publicly available technical reports, textbooks, and guesses. It contains no proprietary or restricted data. If this model has been validated at all, it would be only to the extent that it seems to "fly right", and that it possibly complies with published, publicly known, performance data (maximum speed, endurance, etc.). Thus, this model is meant for educational and entertainment purposes only.
This simulation model is not endorsed by the manufacturer. This model is not to be sold.

MODIFIED FILE. This is JSBSim's aircraft/c172p/c172p.xml changed by the TeachX Flight Simulator project (2026) to match Cessna 172P handbook-class performance and to teach correct handling habits (rigging, left-turning tendencies, stalls, spins, ground handling). Every change is listed in flightsim/jsbsim/CHANGES.md; the unmodified original is kept in flightsim/jsbsim/upstream/. The tables between the TEACHX-GENERATED markers are written by flightsim/jsbsim/tools/gen_model.py (edit the parameters there, not the numbers here). It is a learning aid, not validated flight-training data.

function.name: aero/function/kCDge
function.description: Change_in_drag_due_to_ground_effect

function.name: aero/function/kCLge
function.description: Change_in_lift_due_to_ground_effect

function.name: aero/function/velocity-induced-fps
function.description: velocity including the propulsion induced velocity.

function.name: aero/function/qbar-induced-psf
function.description: q bar including the propulsion induced velocity.

function.name: aero/function/tail-slipstream-share
function.description: TeachX: share of the tail that feels the propeller slipstream. At high angle of attack the slipstream passes above the tail.

function.name: aero/function/qbar-tail-psf
function.description: TeachX: dynamic pressure at the tail. Only part of the tail sits in the propeller slipstream, so blend free stream and slipstream.

function.name: aero/function/engine-torque-ftlb
function.description: TeachX: engine torque on the propeller shaft (power / shaft speed), kept finite when the propeller is nearly stopped.

function.name: aero/function/slipstream-immersion
function.description: TeachX: how much of the fin sits inside the propeller slipstream (0.1 to 1). The slipstream narrows most when the aircraft is standing still at high power (radius ratio = sqrt((V+w)/(V+2w)), w = induced velocity), and the fin root is about 0.68 propeller radii above the thrust line, so the fin is hardly touched at the start of the take-off roll and well inside by climb speed.

function.name: aero/function/elevator-effective-rad
function.description: TeachX: elevator deflection that counts for pitching moment. Linear to 15 degrees; the last part of the travel does a little less (a strongly deflected elevator loses effectiveness).

function.name: aero/function/krig
function.description: TeachX: the rigging (wing wash-in, rudder tab) works in attached flow; it fades out as the wing stalls.

function.name: aero/function/kelevator
function.description: TeachX: share of elevator power left at high angle of attack (the tailplane itself stalls when the air meets it at a steep angle)

function.name: aero/function/kfin
function.description: TeachX: share of fin and rudder effectiveness left at high angle of attack (the stalled wing and the tailplane blank the fin).

function.name: aero/function/kfin-damping
function.description: TeachX: share of the fin's weathercock stability and yaw damping left at high angle of attack (the fin sits in the wake of the stalled wing and tailplane; the rudder, lower and further aft, keeps more of its power).

function.name: aero/function/aileron-mean-rad
function.description: TeachX: mean aileron deflection, positive = roll right (left aileron down, right aileron up).

function.name: aero/function/v-safe-fps
function.description: TeachX: true airspeed, never below 30 ft/s (keeps the ratios below finite).

function.name: aero/function/panel-dihedral-rad
function.description: TeachX: sideslip raises the angle of attack of the windward wing (dihedral and high-wing effect); this is the change for the RIGHT wing.

function.name: aero/function/inner-dalpha-rad
function.description: TeachX: how much rolling, sideslip change the angle of attack of the RIGHT inner wing panel (3.45 ft from the centreline); the left panel gets the opposite.

function.name: aero/function/inner-dv
function.description: TeachX: yawing makes the left inner panel faster and the right one slower by this fraction of the airspeed.

function.name: aero/function/alpha-inner-right-rad
function.description: TeachX: angle of attack of the right inner wing panel.

function.name: aero/function/alpha-inner-left-rad
function.description: TeachX: angle of attack of the left inner wing panel.

function.name: aero/function/normal-inner-right
function.description: TeachX: force coefficient perpendicular to the chord of the right inner wing panel, times its dynamic-pressure ratio.

function.name: aero/function/axial-inner-right
function.description: TeachX: force coefficient along the chord (positive = backwards) of the right inner wing panel, times its dynamic-pressure ratio.

function.name: aero/function/normal-inner-left
function.description: TeachX: force coefficient perpendicular to the chord of the left inner wing panel, times its dynamic-pressure ratio.

function.name: aero/function/axial-inner-left
function.description: TeachX: force coefficient along the chord (positive = backwards) of the left inner wing panel, times its dynamic-pressure ratio.

function.name: aero/function/outer-dalpha-rad
function.description: TeachX: how much rolling, sideslip and aileron change the angle of attack of the RIGHT outer wing panel (10.36 ft from the centreline); the left panel gets the opposite.

function.name: aero/function/outer-dv
function.description: TeachX: yawing makes the left outer panel faster and the right one slower by this fraction of the airspeed.

function.name: aero/function/alpha-outer-right-rad
function.description: TeachX: angle of attack of the right outer wing panel.

function.name: aero/function/alpha-outer-left-rad
function.description: TeachX: angle of attack of the left outer wing panel.

function.name: aero/function/normal-outer-right
function.description: TeachX: force coefficient perpendicular to the chord of the right outer wing panel, times its dynamic-pressure ratio.

function.name: aero/function/axial-outer-right
function.description: TeachX: force coefficient along the chord (positive = backwards) of the right outer wing panel, times its dynamic-pressure ratio.

function.name: aero/function/normal-outer-left
function.description: TeachX: force coefficient perpendicular to the chord of the left outer wing panel, times its dynamic-pressure ratio.

function.name: aero/function/axial-outer-left
function.description: TeachX: force coefficient along the chord (positive = backwards) of the left outer wing panel, times its dynamic-pressure ratio.

function.name: aero/coefficient/CDo
function.description: Drag_at_zero_lift

function.name: aero/coefficient/CDDf
function.description: Delta_drag_due_to_flap_deflection (profile drag)

function.name: aero/coefficient/CDwbh
function.description: Drag_due_to_lift (induced drag = K x CL^2, reduced close to the ground)

function.name: aero/coefficient/CDsep
function.description: TeachX: drag of separated flow beyond the stall (rises to a flat plate broadside-on)

function.name: aero/coefficient/CDhyst
function.description: TeachX: extra drag while the wing stays stalled (stall hysteresis)

function.name: aero/coefficient/CDDe
function.description: Drag_due_to_Elevator_Deflection

function.name: aero/coefficient/CDbeta
function.description: Drag_due_to_sideslip (TeachX: grows with the square of the sideslip, table to 90 degrees)

function.name: aero/coefficient/CYb
function.description: Side_force_due_to_beta (TeachX: extended to 90 degrees of sideslip)

function.name: aero/coefficient/CYdr
function.description: Side_force_due_to_rudder

function.name: aero/coefficient/CYp
function.description: Side_force_due_to_roll_rate

function.name: aero/coefficient/CYr
function.description: Side_force_due_to_yaw_rate

function.name: aero/coefficient/CYswirl
function.description: TeachX: the spiralling propeller slipstream pushes the fin to the right (this is the side force that goes with the nose-left yawing moment Cnswirl)

function.name: aero/coefficient/CYrig
function.description: TeachX: side force of the fixed rudder tab (goes with Cnrig)

function.name: aero/coefficient/CLwbh
function.description: Lift_due_to_alpha (TeachX: all angles of attack, flaps included, clear stall break)

function.name: aero/coefficient/CLhyst
function.description: TeachX: lift lost while the wing stays stalled (stall hysteresis): after a full stall the lift does not come back until the angle of attack is well below the stall angle

function.name: aero/coefficient/CLDe
function.description: Lift_due_to_Elevator_Deflection

function.name: aero/coefficient/CLadot
function.description: Lift_due_to_alpha_rate

function.name: aero/coefficient/CLq
function.description: Lift_due_to_pitch_rate

function.name: aero/coefficient/Clwing
function.description: TeachX: rolling moment of the four wing panels (left normal force minus right normal force, times each panel's arm). Gives roll damping, dihedral effect, roll due to yaw rate and aileron power in normal flight, and a dropping / autorotating wing beyond the stall.

function.name: aero/coefficient/Clr
function.description: Roll_moment_due_to_yaw_rate (fin part; the wing part is in Clwing)

function.name: aero/coefficient/Cldr
function.description: Roll_moment_due_to_rudder

function.name: aero/coefficient/Clrig
function.description: TeachX: fixed rigging (wing wash-in) that balances engine torque in cruise

function.name: aero/coefficient/Cmo
function.description: Pitching_moment_at_zero_alpha

function.name: aero/coefficient/Cmalpha
function.description: Pitch_moment_due_to_alpha (TeachX: all angles of attack, extra nose-down break at the stall)

function.name: aero/coefficient/Cmhyst
function.description: TeachX: pitching-moment shift while the wing stays fully stalled (stall hysteresis). Lets a developed spin hold its angle of attack; it disappears as soon as the angle of attack is reduced.

function.name: aero/coefficient/Cmq
function.description: Pitch_moment_due_to_pitch_rate

function.name: aero/coefficient/Cmadot
function.description: Pitch_moment_due_to_alpha_rate

function.name: aero/coefficient/Cmde
function.description: Pitch_moment_due_to_elevator_deflection (TeachX: tail dynamic pressure blends free stream and slipstream)

function.name: aero/coefficient/Cmdf
function.description: Delta_pitching_moment_due_to_flap_deflection (TeachX: retuned, see CHANGES.md)

function.name: aero/coefficient/Cnb
function.description: Yaw_moment_due_to_beta (TeachX: extended to 90 degrees of sideslip, fin blanking at high alpha)

function.name: aero/coefficient/Cnp
function.description: Yaw_moment_due_to_roll_rate

function.name: aero/coefficient/Cnr
function.description: Yaw_moment_due_to_yaw_rate

function.name: aero/coefficient/Cnrfus
function.description: TeachX: yaw damping of the fuselage in cross-flow at high angle of attack

function.name: aero/coefficient/Cnrr
function.description: TeachX: cross-flow yaw damping that grows with the square of the yaw rate (matters only in spins)

function.name: aero/coefficient/Cnda
function.description: Yaw_moment_due_to_aileron (adverse yaw)

function.name: aero/coefficient/Cndr
function.description: Yaw_moment_due_to_rudder

function.name: aero/coefficient/Cnwing
function.description: TeachX: yawing moment from unequal chordwise force of the left and right wing panels (yaw due to roll rate in normal flight; yaw toward a stalled wing)

function.name: aero/coefficient/Cnswirl
function.description: TeachX: spiralling propeller slipstream striking the left side of the fin and rear fuselage: nose-left yawing moment proportional to engine torque

function.name: aero/coefficient/Cnrig
function.description: TeachX: fixed rudder tab that balances the slipstream in cruise
